model_rate_cards_project_identity_unique.name: model_rate_cards_project_identity_unique
model_rate_cards_project_identity_unique.where: "model_rate_cards"."organization_id" is not null and "model_rate_cards"."project_id" is not null

model_rate_cards_scope_check.name: model_rate_cards_scope_check
model_rate_cards_scope_check.value: ("model_rate_cards"."organization_id" is null and "model_rate_cards"."project_id" is null) or ("model_rate_cards"."organization_id" is not null and "model_rate_cards"."project_id" is not null)

studio_table_preferences_owner_check.name: studio_table_preferences_owner_check
studio_table_preferences_owner_check.value: ("studio_table_preferences"."owner_kind" = 'project' AND "studio_table_preferences"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("studio_table_preferences"."owner_kind" = 'user' AND "studio_table_preferences"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

telemetry_scores_value_check.name: telemetry_scores_value_check
telemetry_scores_value_check.value:
(
      ("telemetry_scores"."data_type" = 'BOOLEAN' and "telemetry_scores"."value" in ('0'::jsonb, '1'::jsonb)) or
      ("telemetry_scores"."data_type" = 'CATEGORICAL' and jsonb_typeof("telemetry_scores"."value") = 'string') or
      ("telemetry_scores"."data_type" = 'NUMERIC' and jsonb_typeof("telemetry_scores"."value") = 'number')
    )
